title: FIS AI Kit Preferences
description: Schema for .fis/config.yaml, the two-tier preference file. The project file at ./.fis/config.yaml overrides the same key in the user file at ~/.fis/config.yaml. Field names are snake_case. For the legacy .claude/.fisrc.json format see fis-config.schema.json.

version.description: Schema version this file was written against. Omit to track the current version.

coding_level.description: How much explanation you want in answers: -1 disabled, 0 eli5, 1 junior, 2 mid-level, 3 senior, 4 expert, 5 architect

privacy_block.description: Block reads of files that usually hold secrets (.env, credentials, keys)

statusline_quota.description: Show the 5h / weekly quota chips in the statusline

statusline_layout.description: Statusline layout override, carried through unconverted. Unlike the rest of this file, its interior uses the layout object's own key names (baseMode, lines, sections, sectionConfig, theme, responsiveBreakpoint, maxAgentRows, todoTruncation) so one layout definition is portable between this file and .fisrc.json.

paths.description: Where this project keeps its documentation and plans

max_loc.description: Maximum lines per documentation file before warning

issue_prefix.description: Prefix for issue references (e.g. GH-, JIRA-). null uses #<id>.

reports_dir.description: Subdirectory for reports within a plan

resolution.description: How the active plan is resolved

order.description: Resolution strategies in priority order. 'session' and 'pointer' are directive; 'branch' only suggests. 'pointer' is the plan pinned per worktree and branch, which survives restarts.

branch_pattern.description: Regex extracting a plan slug from a branch name

mode.description: prompt=ask questions, auto=auto-validate, strict=require all, none=skip

project.description: Detection overrides for a repository the defaults read wrong

locale.description: Language for responses and for thinking. null means English / match the user.

git.description: Git platform settings. Workflows that create issues, branches, and merge requests read the provider from here.

provider.description: auto detects from the origin remote

auto.description: Write a journal entry at the end of a workflow without asking

trust.description: Trust mode for auto-approval. `passphrase` is a credential and is only read from the user config; a project file setting it is ignored.

model.description: Gemini model used by skills that delegate to the Gemini CLI

skills.description: Per-skill configuration, keyed by skill id

use_gemini.description: Delegate research to the Gemini CLI. Opt-in; requires a working CLI.

simplify.description: The code-simplifier gate that runs on prompt submit. Signals are recomputed live from `git diff HEAD`.

enabled.description: Master toggle, off by default. FIS_SIMPLIFY_DISABLED=1 always bypasses.

soft_verbs.description: Verbs that warn instead of blocking

threshold.description: Diff-size limits that trigger the gate

workflow_artifact_gate.description: Proof required before a workflow ships

hooks.description: Per-hook toggles, keyed by the hook script's basename. A hook not listed here is enabled; only an explicit false disables it.

pattern.description: Glob pattern for files to match

message.description: Message shown when the rule is violated

extensions.description: Settings this build does not model. Nothing here is validated or converted, and nothing is guaranteed to survive an upgrade.

keys.description: Credentials. User config only — a project file is committed, so this section is ignored there.

api.description: API endpoints and tokens. User config only — a project file is committed, so this section is ignored there.
